description: Hand-written messages for checking guidance retrieval. Written by the project, not collected from real users. 'expected_sources' lists the corpus sources that would be a correct first result; an empty list means nothing should be returned. Ambiguous items are reported but left out of precision and recall. The 'development' split was used while adjusting the matching rules. The 'check' split was written after the rules were frozen.
